zh-CN.title: 开发者工作台，更清晰
items: 应用列表与详情减少重复标题和嵌套，完善横竖屏及深色模式
创建和编辑应用改为三步填写，保存后直接查看草稿，保留独立的提审与审批确认

en.title: A clearer developer workspace
items: Simpler application lists and details with fewer repeated headings, refined for portrait, landscape and dark mode
Create and edit applications in three steps, then open the saved draft directly; submission and approval remain separate confirmations
